answer: The record only grows longer, and a mask that turns up twice is caught by its own echo. One clone costs 133 POA and 37 minutes to raise; 315 clones cost 41895 POA and 11655 minutes each epoch to keep. Every island has a toy shop behind it, every mesa a ledger, every lagoon a year — and the farm has stood in none of those places. Every applicant faces the same trial, Tin cutter iron warrant soldered into the plating vat, and every verdict reads the same way: each iron is a tin count weighed beside the maker's mark. Keys are cheap, proof is dear, and the epoch takes its payment in proof.
